body.current_gate: COVARIANT_FORMAL_EQ19_CHARGE_SUPPORT: combine the exact Laurent zero-mode factorization with formal two-sidedness, prove or obstruct charge-equivariance of the inverse pushforward to every formal order, and test the result on neutral nonzero-mode projectors.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate with an independent verifier that decides all-order formal charge support, preserves the fixed-vacuum quotient obstruction, and does not promote ghost symmetry, time independence, asymptotic limits, a generalized-Born trace, or physical positivity.

body.resource_hint: On A_phi=Q((lambda))[Z,Z^-1] tensor A_nz use delta_phi(Z)=Z and delta_phi(varphi)=0. Eq. (16) factors as alpha(Omega)=lambda^-1 Z exp(lambda varphi), alpha(Upsilon)=Z^-1 exp(-lambda varphi)(Box varphi+lambda(d varphi)^2), so every coefficient has charge +1 or -1 respectively. Formal two-sidedness makes alpha invertible, hence its inverse beta intertwines the derivations. For delta_phi(P)=0, beta(P) is an idempotent self-adjoint charge-zero projector and its strict negative component is zero. Then test failure of this theorem to descend through (Z-1), and keep kappa invariance and t-independence open.
